result.instructions: Tools for myClub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which events do we have next week, and how many spots are left in each?"; "List the members of the Tuesday class group."; "Create a yoga event on Friday 18:00–19:00 in the Main studio.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes myClub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run myclub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run myclub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run myclub_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. myclub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: myclub_get_club
tools.title: Get club information
tools.description: Show basic information about the club: name, domain and settings. Good first call to confirm the connection. myClub API: GET /club.

tools.name: myclub_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List club events, with optional filters for dates, group, venue and changes since a time. myClub API: GET /events.

start_date.description: Date filter as the myClub API accepts it (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Date filter as the myClub API accepts it (ISO 8601).

updated_after.description: Only items changed after this ISO 8601 date-time.

include_participants.description: Include the participants list in each result.

tools.name: myclub_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Show one event by id, including its times, venue, registration settings and participants. myClub API: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: myclub_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List club courses (recurring classes or training series), with optional filters. myClub API: GET /courses.

start_date.description: Date filter as the myClub API accepts it (ISO 8601).

end_date.description: Date filter as the myClub API accepts it (ISO 8601).

updated_after.description: Only items changed after this ISO 8601 date-time.

include_participants.description: Include the participants list in each result.

tools.name: myclub_get_course
tools.title: Get a course
tools.description: Show one course by id, including its schedule, visibility and participants. myClub API: GET /courses/{id}.

tools.name: myclub_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List club members, one page at a time. Member data may be shown only as each member's privacy setting allows. myClub API: GET /members/.

tools.name: myclub_search_members
tools.title: Find members by name
tools.description: Find club members by first and last name. Both names are required. myClub API: GET /members/search.

tools.name: myclub_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Show one member by id, within the member's privacy setting. myClub API: GET /members/{id}.

member_id.description: The member id (from myclub_list_members or myclub_search_members).

tools.name: myclub_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the club's groups (teams, sections or departments). myClub API: GET /groups.

tools.name: myclub_list_group_memberships
tools.title: List a group's memberships
tools.description: List the memberships of one group. myClub API: GET /groups/{id}/memberships.

tools.name: myclub_list_venues
tools.title: List venues
tools.description: List the club's venues. Use a venue id when you create or update an event. myClub API: GET /venues.

tools.name: myclub_list_event_categories
tools.title: List event categories
tools.description: List the club's event categories. Use a category id when you create or update an event. myClub API: GET /event_categories.

tools.name: myclub_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.description: List club notifications (news posts for members), with optional group filter. myClub API: GET /notifications.

visibility.description: Only notifications with this visibility (none, group, club or public).

tools.name: myclub_create_event
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Create a club event. Name, start, end, venue and group are required. Writes to the club's live calendar. myClub API: POST /events.

starts_at.description: Date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-12-01T18:00:00+02:00.

ends_at.description: Date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-12-01T18:00:00+02:00.

group_id.description: Group id that creates the event (from myclub_list_groups).

course_id.description: Course id the event belongs to.

participants_public.description: Show the participants list to other members.

queue_enabled.description: Members may join a waiting queue when the event is full.

allow_comments.description: Members may comment on the event.

tools.name: myclub_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Change fields of an event. Only the event's creator (the API user) may update it; send only the fields to change. myClub API: PUT /events/{id}.

course_id.description: Course id the event belongs to.

participants_public.description: Show the participants list to other members.

queue_enabled.description: Members may join a waiting queue when the event is full.

allow_comments.description: Members may comment on the event.
